verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes a dedicated PCB containing 16 addressable LEDs; the retained values and hardware/layout scope affect the board design, while milestone and payment details are correctly excluded.
The client identifies conflicting LED models, part numbers, and packages and explicitly requests resolution before the design documents can be updated.

The client confirms the exact BOM component and its model, manufacturer, LCSC number, RGBW format, pad count, package, and physical dimensions; these directly determine PCB footprint and array implementation.
The exact LED selection resolves the material part-and-package ambiguity, allowing implementation of the LED array to proceed.
